name: Telltale 1.7.4-beta.1
body:
## New in 1.7.4

- **Grace drafts a reply you send.** Ask "reply to Ryan saying Hi" and she reads the conversation, then shows a draft on a card with **Edit** and **Send**. Nothing is posted until you press **Send**, and a production org still asks first. If no **Send a reply** tool is chosen, she says drafts are copy and paste, and where to choose one in Settings › Connectors.
- **Grace uses your connectors' own tools.** She now sees what each connector you added can do, such as Slack, your tickets or your wiki, and picks the right tool for each ask, instead of relying on how you matched them in **Use for**. She only reads with them; a reply still waits for your **Send**.
- **Your connectors are checked when Telltale opens.** A connector that needs signing in again, or has stopped answering, shows up straight away instead of the first time Grace tries it.

## Fixed in 1.7.4

- **Slack tools are matched to the right job.** Search messages now uses the tool that searches messages, and Read a thread uses the one that reads a thread, instead of the channel search and the channel reader. A Slack connector you set up before is corrected the first time Telltale checks it, and a tool you picked yourself is left as you chose it.
- **A Slack link or DM reads the first time.** When one tool has nothing or fails, Telltale tries the next best one for the same job, such as the channel history around a message, and Grace says which tool answered.
- **Grace says what she can do in Slack.** She no longer calls herself read only and then lists a tool that sends, or asks you to copy and paste when you can send from the draft.
